constraints: Match real chat: motorcycle purchase → Start New Application → mobile → state → city → address → CC → model → dealer/store → dealer code 10441 → undertaking PDF → submit. Use testdata; invalid city tests use Mumbai in Haryana etc.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Motorcycle purchase edge - city not in state
goal: Verify bot rejects city that does not belong to selected state (e.g. Chandigarh when Haryana selected with strict validation)

phases.description: Provide Haryana and reach city prompt
Enter Chandigarh when state is Haryana

phases.recoveryHint: Bot may say 'not valid city for Haryana' or 'not a city where we have facility' — either counts as rejection
